g.text: Natural retrieval: probe acquisition and router capacity
Three development families × two backends: 365 family-specific queries, reused in 730 query–backend evaluations.
Lookahead averages three probe seeds. Orange brackets use target labels and floating LP bounds; they are not deployable policies.
Quality comparison only: onboarding and serving costs differ. Seeds and backends share queries; no macro confidence interval is shown.
